description: JobRadar guard: enforces upload, navigation, JavaScript and typing limits on Claude in Chrome while applying (docs/THREAT_MODEL.md, A5).

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && if grep -qs '^name = "jobradar"' pyproject.toml; then uv run --no-sync --quiet python -m jobradar.guard.hook || exit 2; fi
